applicationRole.description: Customer-defined application role mapped to one WebSak access template ID.

department.description:
One exact external department ID resolved against the department Gid_DIV1 value.
Delimited lists are not supported.

externalId.description:
Stable client-managed identifier. Entra maps objectId here; UserAPI stores
the value in Gid_DIV2 and uses it for the modern login mapping.
